notes.title: Super Drift Blade Update #71–82
notes.content:
Hi everyone:

This batch of updates focuses on puzzle adjustments, UI improvements, and preventing accidental save deletion, while also adding AZERTY keyboard support and fixing several bugs.

[h2]- Update - [/h2]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for AZERTY keyboards (default remains QWERTY, but ZQSD can also be used; the letters on the sprite’s face will switch automatically).
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redrew and updated several clue maps/illustrations.
[*] Adjusted scenes with hidden paths and added clearer hints.
[*] Adjusted the position of key elements in certain puzzles and increased trigger areas to make them easier to activate.
[*] Added a dialogue range indicator to make conversations easier.
[*] Scenes now become slightly more transparent when the character interacts with them.
[*] Adjusted the position of the dialogue box at the character’s feet for better visibility.
[*] Lowered the difficulty of the “Roulette Game.”
[*] Removed collision from some trees in the “Tortoise and Hare Race,” “Bamboo Shoot Snatching,” and “Pulling Radish” maps.
[*] Adjusted credits menu so placeholders no longer display incorrectly.
[*] Added the most important person to the credits — you, the player.
[*] Adjusted the style of some map icons and added new decorations/vegetation to certain maps.
[*] The Fixers’ Alliance has removed the “Delete All Data” button between the first ending and the final ending, preventing players from accidentally erasing their save data.
[*] Improved English localization in some areas.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where screenshots could not be taken while paused.
[*] Fixed an issue where a medkit in a certain map could open unintentionally.
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain integrated achievement could not be triggered correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Super Drift Blade Update #70
notes.content:
Hi everyone:

Thanks everyone for the feedback!
Within 8 days after launch, the game received 11 updates, fixing numerous issues and continuously improving puzzles, hit detection, text, and combat experience.
(2025/08/12 - 2025/08/20, 11 updates in total, version 1.0.0.0 → 1.0.1.1, latest build #70.)
Here is the consolidated list of major updates:

[h3]Scene & Object Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the stones next to the beach volleyball.
[*] Adjusted trees next to a certain lake.
[*] Adjusted bamboo collision volume.
[*] Adjusted the position of a tree on the grassland.
[*] Adjusted positions of multiple trees in a forest on the grassland.
[*] Removed a large boulder in the forest.
[*] Deleted a scene that could trap the character.
[*] Adjusted overall placement of some scenes.
[*] Adjusted positions of some UI elements.
[*] Updated the credits list.
[/list]
[h3]Puzzle & Detection Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased trigger range for Hidden Sprite #1.
[*] Increased trigger range for Hidden Sprite #2.
[*] Increased trigger range for Hidden Sprite #3.
[*] Increased trigger range for the large triangular Hidden Sprite.
[*] Increased detection area for successful stone circle placement.
[*] Increased detection area for white sand fox balls.
[*] Increased detection area for red sand fox balls.
[*] Increased detection area for carrots.
[*] Increased detection area for snowmen.
[*] Increased detection range for X stones.
[*] Increased detection area for message bottles.
[*] Further increased puzzle detection areas.
[*] Increased puzzle detection time for a certain puzzle, making it easier to trigger.
[*] Enlarged detection areas for some small puzzles.
[*] Redrew some clue images for better readability.
[/list]
[h3]Dialogue & Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted dialogue detection range, expanded multiple times.
[*] Further increased dialogue detection area.
[*] QQ group QR code detection still works; added new QQ group number.
[/list]
[h3]Combat & System Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shortened overall combat duration for faster pacing.
[*] Adjusted Fever time reduction bonus to complete battles faster.
[*] Increased selection speed.
[*] Increased animation speed for upgrades, item selection, and refresh frames.
[*] Adjusted some upgrade values for more rewards.
[*] Added anti-crash feature: switching out of the game and returning to desktop no longer deducts health.
[/list]
[h3]Text & Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple Japanese text errors.
[*] Fixed Simplified Chinese text errors.
[*] Fixed Traditional Chinese text errors.
[*] Fixed some English text errors.
[*] Adjusted some upgrade and UI prompt texts.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed slow weapon issue.
[*] Fixed hidden door trigger issue.
[*] Fixed puzzle ghosting in menu.
[*] Fixed flower reflection display issue.
[*] Fixed initial map terrain display issue.
[*] Fixed detection issues in certain passages.
